rationale: Additional concrete measurement consumers: current test_references._analysis constructs module universe twice per source; production generation._validate_recipes replays grounding, association validates attached native evidence again, resolution WitnessResolutionView revalidates association and repeated hypotheses properties rescan records. Current ContextTools._reference_analysis rebuilds interpretations/universe per requested address and is shared by map/relationship views. Structural-discrimination capture already prepares universe/index/reference facts once per invocation and reuses them across3 lanes with strong references. These are different authority/schema scopes, not a reason to copy historical memo caches. Existing nine one-per-need capture samples44.7253-143.1456ms are heterogeneous single observations, not a benchmark proving cache benefit. Existing proposal sufficient: measure two real production consumers and exact work counts under fresh/changed source before selecting an invocation-local canonical seam; reject stale identity reuse and preserve work-bound refusal before replay.
duplicate_disposition: Existing substantive proposal is sufficient with this exact new evidence/acceptance qualification; no duplicate, approval, grant, B-number, dispatch, status change or closure.
